name: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

angles.text: Scholars of the arcane value recoverd notes from prominent figures like Archmage Theocritus, whose research helps safeguard historical magical treatises in Ironforge's archives.
Securing rare texts and journals enriches the grand repository of knowledge housed within the heart of Ironforge for all Alliance scholars.

faq.answer: It is a scholarly research journal belonging to the mage Archmage Theocritus, turned in to the Ironforge Library to preserve arcane knowledge and expand the archives.
faq.q: What is Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal?

faq.answer: Archmage Theocritus is a renowned human mage who resides in the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest, studying ancient magical disturbances and artifacts.

aliases: where do i turn in theocritus journal
faq.answer: The journal is brought to the archivists within the Library in Ironforge, who collect rare documents and magical manuscripts for their collection.
The scholars at the Ironforge Library seek to preserve arcane knowledge and study rare treatises from master spellcasters to expand their historical records.
faq.q: Why does the library want this journal?

aliases: are there other books for library
faq.answer: Yes, the curators encourage adventurers to continue seeking out lost magical works and historical texts across the world to aid their archival collection.
faq.q: Can more magical works be delivered to the library?

faq.answer: The journal contains notes and observations compiled by Archmage Theocritus during his extensive investigations into magical phenomena and arcane lore.
faq.q: What kind of research is contained in the journal?

sections.body: Archmage Theocritus is known throughout the Alliance as an esteemed spellcaster stationed at the Tower of Azora in the eastern reaches of Elwynn Forest. Over years of solitary study, Theocritus has investigated curious artifacts, ley line anomalies, and nearby magical threats, recording his findings within detailed journals. Recovering such a volume represents a rare opportunity to study the personal observations of a senior Kirin Tor archmage.
sections.title: A Master's Field Notes

sections.body: The Explorers' League and the caretakers of the Ironforge Library maintain one of the greatest archival repositories on the continent. By delivering Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal to their care, adventurers ensure that its arcane insights are safely preserved and cataloged alongside the historic volumes of Khaz Modan. The librarians actively welcome any further magical discoveries that can broaden their collective wisdom.
sections.title: Expanding the Ironforge Archives

summary: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal is an arcane volume documenting the investigations of the master mage of the Tower of Azora. Delivered to the scholars of the Ironforge Library, the journal adds valuable magical insights to the great dwarven archive.
